title: Ragasiya Police
desc: Surya, a police officer, is removed from a case when he is on the verge of tracing the culprit. However, when it is handed to his friend and he gets killed, Surya sets out to catch the killer.

title: Pournami Nagam
desc: To obtain a magical stone, a group of girls attack a cobra couple. Unfortunately, the male cobra dies while his partner escapes. Infuriated, she decides to take revenge.

title: Thadam
desc: While investigating the death of a man, the police track down their lead suspect. However, the case takes a twisted turn when they discover a clone of their suspect.

title: Deiva Vaakku
desc: Hamsaveni's divine power earns her respect among the villagers, whereas her brother, Vallatharai, tries to exploit her power for his personal gain. He goes to the extent of sabotaging her marriage.

title: Azhagiya Tamizh Magan
desc: A disturbing vision prompts a man to flee his impending marriage, but he soon realises that his wicked look-alike has stolen his identity.
